# S5 — Config-driven priority mapping + str-valued per-project create_defaults (a881)

## Context / Problem

Epic 3d7a makes the reconciler's rebar↔Jira mappings config-driven over the S1
seam (`rebar_reconciler/mapping_config.py`: `MappingLayer` axes, `SKIP`,
`resolve_for_project`, `validate`). S2 made STATUS config-driven via
`config.effective_status_map` (`config.py:77`), resolved per project by
`outbound_differ._effective_status_map_for` (`:272`) and threaded through the
backend wrapper/protocol on BOTH create and update.

S5 makes PRIORITY config-driven the SAME way and adds a str-valued per-project
`create_defaults` axis. Both axes already exist in `MappingLayer`
(`priority_map`, `create_defaults`; both in `_AXIS_MAPS`, `mapping_config.py:44`).

Priority is a SOFT field: an UNMAPPED priority DRIFTS (leave Jira's value, omit
the field, warn) — it does NOT fail the sync. No priority VOCABULARY axis exists
(`validate`, `config.py:328`), so this plan carries **no fail-closed claim for
priority** — map-or-drift+warn only, identical to S2 status.

### Verified constraints
- **Parser is str/SKIP-only.** `_parse_axis_map` (`mapping_config.py:120`) raises
  `MappingConfigError` on any non-`str`/`SKIP` value, so EVERY axis map (incl.
  `create_defaults`) is effectively `Mapping[str,str]`; object/array values are
  inexpressible.
- **`config.py` imports nothing but `__future__` at top level;** it RE-DECLARES
  status literals in-module (`local_to_jira_status:35`, `jira_to_local_status:64`)
  to avoid a core→adapter inversion. Priority follows suit — NO top-level import
  of `LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA`.
- **Built-in priority map is INT-keyed** `dict[int,str]` 0–4 (`value_maps.py:22`);
  config `priority_map` is STR-keyed (`_parse_axis_map` does `out[str(key)]`).
- **ACLI does int-subscript arithmetic** — `acli_cli_ops.py:370`
  `_LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA[int(_id)-1]` (reverse-id lookup, bug
  5010-1c6a-9387-4b5b); `:359` + `acli.py:175` int `.get`. A str-keyed map breaks
  these → ACLI is LEFT UNCHANGED.

## Approach

**Key-type reconciliation (in-module, no import).** Add to `config.py` a
str-keyed baseline `local_to_jira_priority: dict[str,str] =
{"0":"Highest","1":"High","2":"Medium","3":"Low","4":"Lowest"}`, re-declared
in-module like the status literals (a parity test pins it against
`value_maps.LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA`, mirroring the status parity test). New
`config.effective_priority_map(project_key, root=None) -> dict[str,str]` mirrors
`effective_status_map`: `builtin =
mc.MappingLayer(priority_map=local_to_jira_priority)`, resolve, drop `SKIP`. Str
overlay keys override the str built-in per-key; consumers look up by
`str(priority)`.

New shared helper `resolve_outbound_priority(value, priority_map) -> str|None` in
`outbound_mapper.py`, beside `resolve_outbound_status` (`:47`): return
`priority_map.get(str(value))` (built-in when `None`); on miss → warn once (reuse
`reset_drift_warnings` sink, `:31`) and return `None` (DRIFT → caller OMITS the
field, never coerces to "Medium").

**Resolve-and-thread seam (priority analog of S2).**
- NEW `outbound_differ._effective_priority_map_for(ticket, mapping, repo_root)` —
  analog of `_effective_status_map_for` (`:272`).
- CREATE thread: `outbound_mutation_builders.py:88` passes `priority_map=` into
  the backend's `map_local_to_remote` (currently only `status_map=`).
- UPDATE thread: `outbound_mutation_builders.py:236` passes `priority_map=` into
  `compute_update_fields` (`outbound_field_diff.py:235`, param `:249`), which
  forwards to `map_fields_to_remote`.

**Symbol→file attribution (CORRECTED).** `map_local_to_remote` is the CREATE-path
method on the Protocol + backend adapters; `map_fields_to_remote` is the
UPDATE-path method (the ONLY mapper method `outbound_mapper.py` defines — it does
NOT define `map_local_to_remote`).

## Scope — every `status_map` carrier gains+forwards `priority_map`

CREATE path (`map_local_to_remote`), all four sites verified forwarding
`status_map` today:
- `_backend.py:372` — `OutboundMapper` Protocol `map_local_to_remote` signature.
- `adapters/jira/backend.py:73` — Cloud `JiraBackend.map_local_to_remote`
  (forwards `status_map` at `:89` into `_map_local_to_jira_fields`).
- `adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py:121` — DC `map_local_to_remote` (forwards
  into `_map_local_to_dc_fields` at `:134`).
- Leaf create bodies:
  `adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py:_map_local_to_jira_fields` (`:101`, priority
  `:144`) and `adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py:_map_local_to_dc_fields`
  (`:60`, priority `:87`).

UPDATE path (`map_fields_to_remote`):
- `_backend.py:393` — Protocol `map_fields_to_remote` signature.
- `adapters/jira/backend.py:92` — Cloud `map_fields_to_remote`.
- `adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py:136` — DC `map_fields_to_remote`.
- `adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py:94` —
  `OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote` (the shared leaf; priority `:144`).

Each leaf replaces its `.get(...,"Medium")` with `resolve_outbound_priority`;
`None` OMITS `priority`. Default `priority_map=None` → built-in
(behaviour-preserving).

Core/config:
- `config.py`: NEW in-module `local_to_jira_priority`, `effective_priority_map`,
  `effective_create_defaults`.
- `outbound_differ.py`: NEW `_effective_priority_map_for`.
- `outbound_mutation_builders.py`: thread `priority_map` (create `:88`, update
  `:236`).
- `outbound_field_diff.py:compute_update_fields`: NEW `priority_map` param.

LEFT UNCHANGED: `adapters/jira/acli.py:175`, `adapters/jira/acli_cli_ops.py:359,
370` (int-keyed, load-bearing int-subscript reverse-id lookup, bug 5010).

**create_defaults (str-valued ONLY).** Because `_parse_axis_map` accepts only
str/`SKIP`, `create_defaults` is str→str. New
`config.effective_create_defaults(project_key, root=None) -> dict[str,str]`
resolves the axis (three-layer merge, no vocab gating). Merged into BOTH create
leaf bodies FIRST, then baseline computed fields win on collision. Baseline (from
code): Cloud (`outbound_fields.py:141-149`) summary/description/issuetype/
priority/assignee/(cond)status/parent; DC (`backend.py:79-92`) same minus parent;
`project` added by the caller. **required-beyond-baseline** = a createmeta-
required field NOT in that set with a plain STRING value. Object/array-valued
requireds are inexpressible by the parser → OUT of scope, filed as a
`discovered_from` follow-up. UPDATE applies NO create_defaults (create-only,
echo-safe).

No file nears the 800-LOC cap; all edits are localized additions.

## Testing
Unit only; offline; no network. Fixtures build a `[mapping]` overlay with
`projects.<KEY>.priority_map` (str keys) and str-valued `.create_defaults`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `test_priority_config_effect` — a `projects.KEY.priority_map` str overlay
      (`"2"="P2"`) overrides the str built-in; effective map + all three payload
      consumers (Cloud create, DC create, update) emit the overlaid name.
- [ ] `test_priority_drifts` — a priority absent from the effective map DRIFTS:
      `resolve_outbound_priority` returns `None`, the payload OMITS `priority`
      (never "Medium"), a warning is recorded, sync does NOT fail.
- [ ] `test_create_defaults_applied` — resolved str-valued `create_defaults`
      merge into BOTH create bodies for required-beyond-baseline fields, baseline
      fields win on collision, and UPDATE applies none.

Test tier: unit
